baseline: single fixed V8 trajectory; all active anchors stop at depth10
early_exit: only 0.60/0.70/0.80 may stop at depth9; 0.90/0.95 remain at depth10
score: frozen clean-lineage V13 0.80 mask-value logit at V8 depth9; no new features or model training
risk_curve: on train1421 only, describe top 1%, 2%, 5%, 10%, and 20% by score, counting every paired anchor and Complete break and mean final-context cost
single_candidate_rule: freeze the score threshold at the 10% highest train-query score before any fold4 outcome is read; switch every future query with score at least that value
opening_gate: the 10% train-side candidate must switch at least 100 queries, cause zero baseline-to-policy breaks at every active anchor and Complete, and lower all-query mean final-context fraction
exposed_gate: apply the frozen threshold once on design-exposed fold4=611; require no anchor or Complete break and lower context cost to claim a research-level Pareto gain; otherwise stop this feature branch
causal_limit: V13 has seen train1421 and fold4=611 queries; even a positive result must later pass the B2B lineage-clean 581 before any fresh confirmation or final claim
